etc/pacman.conf.text:
[options]
HoldPkg = pacman glibc
Architecture = aarch64
CheckSpace
ParallelDownloads = 5
DownloadUser = alpm
SigLevel = Required DatabaseOptional
LocalFileSigLevel = Optional

# Aurora kernel and bootloader, kept on the qualified release by omarchy update
[omarchy-aurora]
SigLevel = Required DatabaseOptional
Server = https://github.com/maralcbr/omarchy-pkgs/releases/download/aurora-packages-3caea4693df7c472d57809b5c6b05b07579c1f7a

[omarchy]
SigLevel = Required DatabaseOptional
Server = https://github.com/maralcbr/omarchy-pkgs/releases/download/asahi-packages-stable-2949b88ccfc303e3c423106eafa68c9088ab6eea

[asahi-alarm]
SigLevel = Required DatabaseOptional
Server = https://github.com/asahi-alarm/asahi-alarm/releases/download/aarch64

[core]
Server = https://ca.us.mirror.archlinuxarm.org/$arch/$repo
Server = https://fl.us.mirror.archlinuxarm.org/$arch/$repo

[extra]
Server = https://ca.us.mirror.archlinuxarm.org/$arch/$repo
Server = https://fl.us.mirror.archlinuxarm.org/$arch/$repo

[alarm]
Server = https://ca.us.mirror.archlinuxarm.org/$arch/$repo
Server = https://fl.us.mirror.archlinuxarm.org/$arch/$repo

[aur]
Server = https://ca.us.mirror.archlinuxarm.org/$arch/$repo
Server = https://fl.us.mirror.archlinuxarm.org/$arch/$repo
